title: Guarded LLM triage with an eval gate
scenario: A hackathon Lambda sends IVR transcripts to Claude on Bedrock and returns the JSON straight to the flow: transcript in the system prompt, no guardrail, no timeout, and callers can talk their way to P1. Harden it and build the offline eval gate the CAB asked for, using recorded Converse responses only.
task: Static system prompt, transcript in a fenced user turn, temperature 0, small max tokens, guardrail on
Strict output contract with fallbacks for invalid output, guardrail, timeout and errors
Deterministic guards: P1 only for real outages, injection containment, PII out of summaries
Eval harness: accuracy, schema-valid, fallback, injection containment, priority ceilings, gate
acceptance: Request contract and output handling tests pass against recorded fixtures
Slow or failing model calls fall back within the budget
Eval metrics exact on stub and recorded runs; injections contained
ANSWER.md interprets the gate result and proposes next steps
